title: EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification
description: EuroSAT is a land use and land cover classification dataset. The dataset is based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery covering 13 spectral bands and consists of 10 LULC classes with a total of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images. The dataset is associated with the publications "Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification" and "EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification". This catalog contains the multi-spectral version of the EuroSAT dataset, which includes all 13 Sentinel-2 bands in the original value range.
